method: Source-grounded partial review domains, expanded by native families. Eligibility means the ontology warrants evaluation of the native item, not that any target is valid. Omitted families and ontologies remain unclassified; do not infer exhaustive denominators. Existing XML is sole mapping authority. Whole-feature review is used for open/mixed fields; categorical observations are selected only when source semantics warrant individual review. Explicit exclusions concern this mapping scope only, not universal ontology inapplicability; excluded units and unrouted units must remain distinct.

bhsa.rationale: R-005 BHSA feature reference: documented parts of speech, grammar, clause/phrase categories and dependency roles; lex nodes and source dictionary-entry features. Expanded ETCBC dependency, morphology, morpheme-form, discourse and lexical representation families; section hierarchy warrants LRMoo review but not every verse is an independent expression. Source morph forms remain native encodings, aliases are not new linguistic concepts. Further distinction: lexical frequencies versus occurrence spelling frequencies, source-local sequence labels, actual dependency distance units, morpheme realization and text representation. Whole closed-category feature containers are assessed through their values; optional property maps remain possible. Direct Git blob comparison established identical complete suffix_*/prs_* payloads at the pinned versions; avoid a duplicate mapping obligation.

exclusions.reason: Individual native morpheme spellings are not independent semantic categories for ontology matching; assess their documented morphological feature/form role instead.

cuc.rationale: Pinned CUC source transcription structure, sign inventory, certainty and editorial emendation fields. CRMtex and CRMinf are relevant review areas; a recorded editorial flag is not an inference event, and a TF sign is not automatically a physical glyph. KTU tablet titles and side designators concern source objects/sections, not verified unique physical object identifiers. Transliteration and alternative readings must remain distinct from physical marks (CRMtex TX1/TX7/TX9). Line-continuation is a graphical/textual annotation; language is a source label. Word node review remains separate from an exact populated-surface guard. Actual sign/usign slot-by-slot comparison supports TX11 review at observed letter-value granularity, including negative review of editorial/layout placeholders; both script views are representations of the same slots, not independent historical grapheme counts. Guarded word transcription views to TX12 remain separately accounted.

peshitta.rationale: Pinned transcription documentation: textual book versions and witness designations; chapter/verse parts are review candidates, not independently whole Expressions. Witness labels are identifiers, so review the feature, not every A/B occurrence. Review the two transcriptions as representations; no identification of individual physical glyphs is implied. Orthographic word category warrants OLiA review; empty slots and attached enclitics prevent an unguarded morphological-word claim.

exclusions.reason: A/B labels are source-local witness identifiers; review the witness property at feature level, not each literal as a distinct ontology category.

pseudepigrapha.rationale: Pinned OCP TF graph and apparatus/translation documentation: source/translated versions, explicit reading and witness structure, variant words; manuscript metadata does not establish a physical carrier. LRMoo R5 requires meaningful structural components, unlike page/line or arbitrary anchor spans; apparatus readings, explicit omissions and source/generated layers remain distinct. Historical classifications and source witness metadata warrant review without fabricating concept, carrier or person identities. Pinned converter distinguishes OCP source identities from generated order/anchor flags, and literal witness lists from witness edges. Review generated language, edition metadata, rights, themes and editorial corrections at feature level. An empty primary-reading anchor is not physical damage. Source-preserved group, div_fragment and edition status require more upstream evidence; leave unresolved. Revalidated against the current scoped TF inventory and reviewed upstream changes.

tlhdig-tf.rationale: Pinned generated data model, feature documentation, source catalogue and join apparatus: morphology, lexeme links, editorial graph, lines/signs, fragment identification and CTH classification. CRMtex/CRM/LRMoo/SKOS/CRMinf are relevant review domains; not claims of class equivalence, physical identity, or explicit inference. Sign-level aGr/d/num/sGr containment flags are graphemic/editorial evidence, not grammatical values on analysis nodes. Join edges are source apparatus projections (CRM physical-relation and CRMinf claim review), not LRMoo expression derivation. Resolution and alignment levels record process evidence, not belief values. CTH is a catalogue grouping; fragment occurrences and docgroup do not prove physical identity. Direct featuremeta.py and editorial.md distinguish source range geometry, recovered/synthesized boundary markers, philological uncertainty, source apparatus selection and parser diagnostics. Source record order, codepoint/record counts and duplicate docid representation do not create extra semantic obligations. sel_group, opaque mrp_control, mixed othertags and undocumented cudirty remain unresolved; do not infer grammatical number or a historical statement from internal selection codes. Complete observed raw analysis.morph values are now included for OLiA research; composite alternatives are source values, not individual ontology classes or selected word tokens.

assyrian-royal-inscriptions.rationale: Pinned generated feature and data-model documentation: POS, lexeme grouping, transcription structure and source-aligned translation ranges; no inference of physical glyph identity. Catalogue fields preserve raw text, including compound materials, uncertain types and multiple collections; review properties, not individual labels as ontology classes. CDLI IDs are not unique document keys. TEI translation ranges are alignment, not one translation per line, and include dollar annotations. Source hierarchy includes synthetic anchors. Source identifiers (including qualified document_key and occurrence IDs) and licences/source archive provenance merit property review, not cross-corpus identity. Distinguish source implicit chunk flag from converter synthetic anchors and metadata/analysis availability; synthetic slots must stay visible for query guards. Raw composite JSON/TEI fields are preserved but not a single semantic mapping unit; their contents are not thereby exhausted. Only the observed tr subtype is counted, not a documented but unobserved dollar alternative.
